candidates.transcript_evidence: Evaluating the impact of electric vehicle incentives on policies.
candidates.description: 评估电动汽车激励政策的影响

candidates.transcript_evidence: what challenges do you foresee in the implementation of this policy?
candidates.description: 询问政策实施中可能遇到的挑战

candidates.transcript_evidence: The policy would probably involve then allowing Chinese imports in so that the actual cost of an electric vehicle comes down.
candidates.description: 提及政策可能涉及允许中国进口以降低电动车实际成本

candidates.transcript_evidence: my petrol car lasts me 12 to 15 years.
candidates.description: 表示自己的汽油车可使用12至15年

candidates.transcript_evidence: I'm not sure, it's eight years or something, the battery.
candidates.description: 对电池寿命约八年表示不确定

candidates.transcript_evidence: So the strategies to propose, the next question is about the strategies you would propose to effectively overcome these challenges.
candidates.description: 转向关于提出策略以克服挑战的话题

candidates.transcript_evidence: Well, mainly bring the price down, I suppose.
I'm answering my own question here.
candidates.description: 评价自己在回答自己的问题

candidates.transcript_evidence: I mean, what worries me is that if you make, I think, if you make, I'm sorry, if you make the idea that it's a selfish idea, electricity from gas, you're not really saving it.
candidates.description: 表达担忧：认为用天然气发电并不真正节省资源，且可能被视为自私

candidates.transcript_evidence: I suppose you lose the carbon in the air.
candidates.description: 评价认为碳会排放到空气中

limitations: 转录中部分话语如'Okay'、'Yes'为简短回应，因缺乏上下文未单独提取为候选。
未提取重复的修正部分如'I think, if you make, I'm sorry, if you make'，仅保留完整语法片段。
